# Marianne Kajbæk Vester-Andersen

Marianne Kajbæk Vester-Andersen is a senior physician and clinical academic serving as Ledende overlæge (Chief Consultant), Ph.D., and clinical lecturer (klinisk lektor) at [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] in Denmark. She is a member of the steering committee of [[danibd|DANIBD]], the Danish National Inflammatory Bowel Disease registry, as documented in the 2023 annual report [^src1].

Vester-Andersen's role at Region Sjælland positions her within the broader Danish healthcare system's response to inflammatory bowel disease (IBD). The DANIBD steering committee, to which she contributes, oversaw treatment data for 33,381 IBD patients across five Danish regions during the 2022–2023 reporting period, with her region being one of five regional treatment centers involved in the registry [^src1]. Her dual qualifications in clinical medicine and research (indicated by her Ph.D. credential) reflect the committee's multidisciplinary composition, which includes representatives from medicine, surgery, nursing, patient advocacy, epidemiology, and data management across Denmark's regional health system.
